ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels in the central and lower regions, transitioning to high-intensity (white/gray) mottled regions towards the lateral tips; estimated ratio of 65:35.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large white patches with black speckled mottling on the distal lobes; solid black pigmentation concentrated at the proximal peduncle junction and lower-median fluke surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide V-shaped central notch with an obtuse internal angle estimated at approximately 135 degrees; shallow depth relative to total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular serrated trailing edge with frequent micro-peaks and irregular valleys across the entire span, isolated against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trailing edge curve sweeping upward toward sharp, outward-pointing distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Discrete clusters of circular dark spots on the distal white regions of both lobes; specifically, a cluster of 5-7 spots on the left lobe and 4-6 on the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two parallel, diagonal high-intensity linear streaks (rake marks) visible in the lower-central dark pigmentation area, left of the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization (Coronula diadema) forming rough, high-relief calcified clusters on the extreme lateral tips of both fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive heavy calcification localized at the terminal points of the lobes, significantly altering the natural geometric profile of the tips.
